Meet the artist

Hi, I’m Aarushi.

I’m an artist, a storyteller, and a self-taught pianist who finds magic in the little details. Whether I’m sketching a cherished memory or discovering a melody by ear, I love turning feelings into something beautiful and deeply personal.

My art is playful, expressive, and made with care—created to celebrate people, relationships, and moments worth holding onto. Every commission becomes a small piece of someone’s story, reimagined through my colours and lines.

ArtistSelf-taught pianistMade in IndiaStoryteller
